entities.summary: Bernard Mosiuoa Mohlalisi O.M.I. was the Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Maseru in Lesotho from 1990 to 2009. On June 30, 2009, his resignation due to age was accepted by Pope Benedict XVI. He was succeeded as Archbishop by Gerard Tlali Lerotholi, O.M.I., a professor at the National University of Lesotho.
